solution.sanitized:
def decode_frames(data):
    out, offset = [], 0
    while offset < len(data):
        size = data[offset]
        offset += 1
        end = offset + size
        if end > len(data):
            raise ValueError("incomplete frame")
        out.append(data[offset:end])
        offset = end
    return out
